title: Ashbury Rewards Award Chart for Free Night Awards Rebooked Nights
content:
The award chart's standard-season prices by category are those of the Ashbury Rewards award chart:

| Award category | Standard-season price (points) |
|---|---|
| 1 | 7500 |
| 2 | 12500 |
| 3 | 17500 |
| 4 | 25000 |
| 5 | 35000 |
| 6 | 45000 |
| 7 | 60000 |
| 8 | 85000 |

**Price clause.** The rebooked night's price recorded on the hold when a member applies one of the Free Night Awards that came back from a cancelled stay is the standard-season price of the award chart for the award category recorded on the new reservation, in whole points. The rebooked night's price is never below zero.

The new reservation is the confirmed Reward Night Rate reservation the returned award is applied to; its award category is the one recorded on that reservation at booking.

### Worked figure (hypothetical rebooking)

A member applies a returned award to a hypothetical new reservation recording award category 3. The standard-season price for category 3 is 17500 points, and the hold records a rebooked night's price of 17500 points.

| Hypothetical category of the new reservation | Rebooked night's price (points) |
|---|---|
| 1 | 7500 |
| 4 | 25000 |
| 7 | 60000 |
